proves.claim: Linking a child with both board signer keys on this machine applies one signed states link on both boards, the current board being the parent.

cli.io-commands-link.signs-one-link.why: Without it, no command makes a cross-board link and a foreign wait stays blocked forever.

proves.claim: A board with no signer refuses BOARD_LINK_AUTH and writes no link on either board.

cli.io-commands-link.missing-signer-refu.why: Without it, a link could be written with only one board's consent.
